chain.fact: Startup-only registration validates and installs the selected provider.
The public commitTimeline route validates the exact project/timeline and canonical invocation path, then enters the coordinator.
The authenticated request port is created and the registered provider's commit method is invoked.
The Astrid provider validates commands, loads the authenticated closure, and calls commands.execute with the request-scoped guards and source inputs.
The operation registry selects doc.patch and dispatches its handler through a Recording backed by State.
Each registered command uses State for guarded reads and writes; captured reads retain the immutable input boundary.
A physical source item birth reaches the approved methods through the registered provider's doc.patch path.
The approved regression test submits through service.commit_timeline with the registered provider and checks accepted canonical persistence plus wrong-previous refusal/no write.

conserved_guards: Exact runtime-document shot/revision/internal identities and content digests remain required; source_mapping.item_id_map must be empty for the physical-source branch.
Physical item IDs remain non-empty unique strings; identity mapping is physical and does not allocate or extend an alias map.
Copied/remapped placements retain strict exact correspondence checks through the existing mapped branch.
Previous-value, wrong-source, malformed-closure, duplicate/empty-ID, and no-write refusal predicates remain in the approved test and surrounding State paths.
Runtime authentication, C0 request/reply DTOs, idempotency, managed closure edges, allocation, and persistence are outside the two approved files and unchanged.
